name: Bondada Engineering Limited
summary: Bondada Engineering Limited provides engineering, procurement, construction, and operations and maintenance services for telecom and solar sectors in India. It also engages in design, procurement, construction, and commissioning of solar project; planning, upgradation, construction, and installation of telecommunications infrastructure, such as monopoles, guyed towers, and lattice towers; railway infrastructure; and data centers maintenance. In addition, the company provides Autoclaved Aerated Concrete blocks under the SmartBrix brand name; uPVC window and door systems under the truVU brand; and aluminium windows and doors under AluRise brand name.
